Found 8 tool(s) — call the one you need directly (params below); it activates on use:

### pdf_to_images [documents]
Render PDF pages to PNG images so you can SEE them with vision. Use this when a PDF contains figures, diagrams, screenshots, charts, tables-as-images, signatures, or scanned content that `parse_document` (text only) cannot convey — e.g. you parsed a PDF's text but the user is asking about something visual in it. Pass `page_range` (e.g. "3-5") to render only the pages you need. Returns a list of page-image paths; then call `analyze_image(image='<path>', question='...')` ONE PAGE AT A TIME to view each (do not bundle pages — providers cap request size).

### tool_manage [system]
Manage dynamic tools at runtime. Add new HTTP or shell tools, list/remove/enable/disable existing ones, or reload from disk. Dynamic tools appear in the tool list immediately without restart. Use this to extend your own capabilities on the fly.
